items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: But I got together with Mr. Zildjian, and, and I wanted, uh, I wanted him to make, uh, cymbals that would, that, that each drummer would like

ctx.x: Yeah. I just wonder if anybody had a big reputation for it. Anyway, what about, uh, cymbals? How did you hit your cymbal? I mean, there's many ways of playing cymbal. Did they, did that change at all through the years?

Well, I don't know, I, I, I, I, like, like I told you about that cymbal I first got, that Zutty got, you know? Yeah. And, uh, well, you see, I don't know what happened with that cymbal, but anyway, later on when I, when I got to New York and I joined, uh, uh, Freddie Rich's band, see? Mm-hmm. I got a whole new set of drums, see? Yeah. I got cymbals and everything else, and, of course, I got, had to, had to get, uh, the company to make drums and, and, and setups and stuff.
